<thought>Using the most intense ESI peak (m/z = 268.1939) as the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is ≈267.1867 Da. Applying the nitrogen rule (odd nominal mass → odd number of nitrogens) and searching for a formula that matches this exact mass within typical high‑resolution tolerance gives the best fit C₁₆H₁₃NO₃, i.e., C16H13O3N.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H13O3N</final_answer>
